title: Long Golden Venezuelan Plantain Patties
description: A kid-friendly Venezuelan dish featuring crispy beurre-noisette and dense, yeasty plantain patties.
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the warm milk, yeast, and 1 teaspoon of sugar. Let it sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, remaining sugar, salt, and 1/2 teaspoon of cumin.
Add the yeast mixture, olive oil, and shredded cheese to the dry ingredients. Mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a long rope.
Cut the rope into 1-inch pieces and flatten each piece slightly into patties.
Fry the patties in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the patties on paper towels and brush with beurre-noisette.
Sprinkle with shredded cheese, green onions, and a pinch of cumin. Serve immediately.
